subject: Krystle Campbell Scholarship and Memorial Tournament
overview: Speakers commemorated Krystle Campbell by highlighting the annual Medford High School memorial softball tournament and scholarship fund established in her honor.

items.title: Krystle Campbell Memorial Softball Tournament and Scholarship
items.summary: Mayor Michael McGlynn, Victoria Rasche, and softball team members discussed honoring Krystle Campbell through an annual softball tournament and a scholarship awarded to Medford High School seniors.
